item.title: Un desarrollador español ha descubierto que su videojuego funciona perfectamente en España. Excepto cuando hay fútbol
item.description: Borja de la Osa, un desarrollador de videojuegos español, prepara el lanzamiento de ' Kuiper ', su primer videojuego para móviles, para el próximo 1 de octubre. Hay un pequeño problema: desde agosto su servidor deja de estar accesible de forma periódica desde buena parte de España. Y ese problema tiene una razón: los bloqueos masivos de IPs de LaLiga durante las emisiones de partidos de fútbol de cada jornada. De la Osa ha documentado esos bloqueos durante semanas y ha encontrado una solución eficaz pero también absurda: cuando el servidor deja de responder en España, el tráfico de 'Kuiper'… Fuente: Xataka.

item.description: The reigning champions are in fine form. After a poor start to their league campaign, PSG came alive on their return to European action, cruising to a 6-1 win over Slovakian side Slovan Bratislava. Ousmane Dembélé, who scored twice and provided two assists, and Ferran Torres, who hit a hat-trick, led PSG to victory. In the other matches, Liverpool edged past Atlético Madrid 2-1, while Barcelona cruised past Feyenoord 5-1. Last season’s runners-up Arsenal secured a 1-0 win over Napoli. item.title: Gay shows his class to give England control against Pakistan
item.description: Emilio Gay produces a gritty, determined innings to guide England out of early trouble as he hits 60 off 114 balls to help his side recover from 39-3 to 143-4 on day one of the third and final Test against Pakistan at Edgbaston. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Ryder Cup race a 'big part' of Lowry's motivation
item.description: Shane Lowry says it is time to get himself "in gear" if he is to secure his spot on Europe's Ryder Cup team for Adare Manor next year. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Hermann equals ODI debut score record in SA win
item.description: Jordan Hermann strikes 150 to equal the record for the highest score in a one-day international debut as South Africa beat Namibia by 99 runs in Windhoek. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: ¿Qué club armó el mejor equipo para ganar la Champions League?
item.description: El máximo torneo de clubes en Europa ya tiene rodando el balón. 36 equipos sueñan con disputar la final en el estadio Metropolitano de Madrid, pero solo unos pocos parten como favoritos para conquistar el trofeo. ¿Qué conjunto se reforzó mejor para la presente edición del campeonato? ¿Cuál es el principal candidato para desbancar al PSG de su título? En France 24 lo revisamos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: LIVE: Napoli vs Arsenal – UEFA Champions League
item.description: Follow live updates from our text commentary stream coverage as favourites Arsenal begin their Champions League season. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: 'This Is Anfield' sign fetches £115k at auction
item.description: The original sign from Liverpool's stadium tunnel fetched almost eight times its estimated guide price. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: LIVE: Liverpool vs Atletico Madrid – Champions League
item.description: Follow updates from the league phase clash, including the build-up, analysis and live text commentary of the game. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: 'What a wicket to get!' - Debutant Razaullah removes Root in first over
item.description: Pakistan debutant Razaullah Khan enjoys a perfect first over in Test cricket as he traps England captain Joe Root lbw for eight, as England fall to 39-3 in their first innings of the third and final Test at Edgbaston. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Spoke brilliantly' but Liverpool fans torn on Mac Allister contract comments
item.description: Alexis Mac Allister splits opinion on his public comments regarding his contract at Liverpool, as fans and BBC Sport pundit Pat Nevin share opinions. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'I'm not a robot' - Kerr responds to criticism before Ingebrigtsen reunion
item.description: Josh Kerr says he is "very happy" to see Jakob Ingebrigtsen back competing - but he is "not going to lose" when they resume their fierce rivalry this weekend. Fuente: BBC Sport.
